 Rock Out Till You Clock Out! Win tickets to Boardwalk Rock Fest 2027!
 By 
 jmoore 
 / 
 October 21, 2026 
 Share: 
 The wait is over! The lineup for the 2027 Boardwalk Rock Festival has been announced as the three-day rock extravaganza is returning to Ocean City, Maryland, May 14–16, 2027.
 SEE BELOW. 
 And if you want to see the lineup live, listen to 98 Rock on Wednesday! 
 ROCK OUT ’TIL YOU CLOCK OUT — WIN TICKETS BEFORE YOU CAN BUY THEM!
 Starting at 9 a.m. and continuing through 5 p.m. Wednesday , 98 Rock is giving you a chance to win tickets to Boardwalk Rock before you can buy them! 
 Tune in to 98 Rock at 97.9 FM, 98online.com or the 98 Rock App throughout the day for your chance to win.
 That’s right — you could score your tickets before they go on sale to everyone else! 
 ROCK OUT ’TIL YOU CLOCK OUT with 98 Rock and get ready for three days of rock on the Ocean City boardwalk.
 BOARDWALK ROCK 2027
 📍 Ocean City, Maryland 
📅 May 14–16, 2027 
 Want to be among the first to know about all things Boardwalk Rock?  Sign up now at BoardwalkRockFest.com . 
 And don’t forget — Wednesday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., it’s ROCK OUT ’TIL YOU CLOCK OUT on 98 Rock! 
 ENTRY PERIOD BEGINS 10/21/2026 AT 9 A.M. AND ENDS 10/21/2026 AT 5 P.M. ENTER ONLY BY LISTENING TO 98 ROCK. 1 WINNER(S) WILL BE SELECTED EACH HOUR BY JUDGES ON THE BASIS OF A CORRECT ANSWER (8 WINNERS TOTAL). DECISIONS OF THE JUDGES WILL BE FINAL. NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. CONTEST OFFERED TO LEGAL U.S. RESIDENTS 18 YEARS OLD OR OLDER WHO LIVE IN MARYLAND, DELAWARE, VIRGINIA AND WASHINGTON DC AS WELL AS ONLY THE FOLLOWING COUNTIES IN PENNSYLVANIA: YORK, HARRISBURG, LANCASTER. LIMIT ONE ENTRY PER PERSON, PER DAY. EMPLOYEES OF ENTITIES ASSOCIATED WITH THE CONTEST AND THEIR HOUSEHOLD & FAMILY MEMBERS ARE INELIGIBLE. DISPUTES SUBJECT TO ARBITRATION IN NY. WINNER MUST RESPOND, CLAIM PRIZE, SIGN RELEASES & THE SWEEPSTAKES FORMS AT THE 98 ROCK STUDIOS. EACH PRIZE: TWO THREE DAY PASSES TO BOARDWALK ROCK FESTIVAL MAY 14-16. ARV OF EACH PRIZE: $600.00. COMPLETE RULES AVAILABLE AT 98ONLINE.COM/CONTEST-RULES.
